open.title: Open your first project
open.body: lich works inside a folder. Open a git repository with the + next to the tabs and your agents will work there.
open.hint: Click + to open a folder and continue

start.title: Start an agent
start.body: A session runs your agent in a real terminal, inside this project.

startShell.title: Start a terminal
startShell.body: lich found no agent on this machine, so a session opens a plain terminal. You can add an agent later in Settings.

stage.title: This is your agent
stage.body: The same CLI you run in your own terminal, with its own keys and commands. Click it and type to talk to it.

stageShell.title: This is your terminal
stageShell.body: A shell in this project. Once an agent is installed, New session opens it here instead.

session.title: Every session gets a row
session.body: Click a row to switch to its session, and right-click it for everything else you can do with it.

worktree.title: One task, one worktree
worktree.body: To work on two things at once, open New Session and pick Worktree. Each one gets its own checkout, so two agents never touch the same files.

menu.title: Come back any time
menu.body: Settings and these guides live in this menu.

skipped.title: The tour is in the menu
skipped.body: Open it again from Guides, in the menu at the top right.
